description: Post a message in an application's thread as the user, whether they are the project owner or the applicant; the other side is e-mailed, as from the Studio. Returns the whole thread. Not possible once the application was withdrawn.

application_id.description: The application's id (from list_project_applications, list_my_applications or apply_to_role).

message.description: The message (sent as the user, to the other side of the application).

name: send_application_message
title: Message about an application
